title: StarterRequest v1
description: Body of POST /aaa/starters. Tenant identity comes only from the server-issued scoped token, never from this body. The journey snapshot is an untrusted observation: the server re-derives eligibility from the Site Profile and never treats client-supplied prices, availability, discounts or eligibility as authoritative. The body carries no URLs.

momentRuleId.description: Profile moment rule that produced the ASSIST decision on the client, if any. Advisory only.

journey.description: Journey snapshot at request time. Its sessionId, profileId, profileVersion, locale and page (pageInstanceId, pageRevision) are echoed in the StarterResult for staleness checks.
